head: T-Mobile prepaid plans from $20 a month may come in April, report says
dek: T-Mobile is reportedly preparing three prepaid plans called T-Select at $20, $30 and $40 a month, according to The Mobile Report, which cites unnamed sources. T-Mobile hasn't announced them.
details: The $20 plan would need your own phone and include unlimited talk, text and data, Scam Shield and T-Mobile Tuesdays. The $30 plan would have 10GB of high-speed data and 5GB of hotspot. The $40 plan would add calls and texts to Canada and Mexico, 15GB of hotspot, a Walmart+ membership and a $25 Walmart credit after three months. Android Authority says they're expected in April; the Walmart perks hint they may be sold at Walmart, which isn't confirmed.
means: If you pay more than $20 a month for prepaid service and bring your own phone, a cheaper T-Mobile option may come next spring.
todo: Nothing to do yet: the plans aren't announced and could change or never launch.
